intent: Twelve distinct evidence tasks on an original book-cover workshop and its update distinguish quantity/grade,action-specific places,bring/provide,deadline/event day,two-clue duration and replacement versus preserved facts. Fresh music-club transfer crosses an hour boundary.
picturePurpose: Readable source cards become selected evidence in code;exact numbers,locations and updates stay original coded text. No decorative generated image replaces reading evidence. Each task has only three relevant source cards,with the complete original notice available on demand.

workshop.title: 读通知，抓准每个细节
